751130101.text: Kind warrior, all my saurians are safe and sound, and all thanks to you!

751130106.text: You've shown such courage and kindness that I, Urubamba, would be honored to help you train for the Warrior's Challenge, completely free of charge!

751130201.text: Once you've made up your mind, don't think too much about it. Just give it your all!

751130401.text: Wow, I'd never have guessed you'd do so well — I clearly underestimated you!

751130402.text: To think that after all that preparation, the challenge prizes would end up being scooped up, just like that, by a total stranger passing through... It almost sounds...

751130403.text: ...Like one of those heroic tales, straight out of a woven scroll!

751130405.text: Maybe someday your heroic deeds will end up being woven into our legends too? In fact, when I put it like that... it sounds quite likely!

751130406.text: So, how about a quick selfie together, hero? Who knows, this photo might just become my source of future bragging rights!
